Useful identification reports explain why a device should have a particular label or icon. A manufacturer clue alone cannot establish an exact product; an unknown or private MAC does not imply a phone.

Share only redacted evidence:

- App revision, macOS version and architecture.
- Public product/model name, expected class and displayed class/icon.
- Identification source: advertised model/service, manufacturer clue, explicit user label or another observation.
- A synthetic fixture or sanitized sample, including evidence age/conflicts when known.
- What was actually checked and what remains unverified.

Replace real addresses and device/instance identifiers consistently. Do not upload private packet captures, network names, serials, credentials or personal screenshots. Do not play media, change device settings or start blocking to collect a report. If you already have an authorized connectivity observation, separate protocol-family and endpoint-side evidence from the app's requested state.

Use the Device identification issue form for an actionable defect. Use this discussion for uncertainty about evidence or a compatibility question.
